Create Practitioner.description: Registers a new health worker as a FHIR Practitioner in iHRIS.

Update Practitioner.description: Replaces an existing Practitioner record in iHRIS by id.

Submit Transaction Bundle.description: Creates or updates several FHIR resources in one transaction, e.g. a worker and their job assignment.

Get Practitioners.description: Fetches health worker (Practitioner) records, following pagination automatically.

Get Practitioners Updated Since.description: Fetches only Practitioners changed since the last sync, for incremental HRH-to-DHIS2 or payroll syncs.

Get Practitioner By ID.description: Reads a single Practitioner record by its id.

Get Job Assignments.description: Fetches PractitionerRole resources (positions/postings) with their Practitioners included.

Get Facilities.description: Fetches facility Location resources, e.g. to map iHRIS duty stations to DHIS2 org units.

List Report Indices.description: Lists the iHRIS reporting indices and their record counts.
